findings.finding: Accepting both spellings does not make the single-ticket form follow its help when the flags come before the ticket id. `compact_cli` always reads `argv[0]` as the ticket id (compact.py:68-72). The argparse help that `rebar store compact --help` prints (`build_compact`) lists the optional flags before `[ticket_id]`. So an operator who copies the help order (`rebar store compact --threshold 8 <id>`, or `--threshold=8 <id>`) gets 'ticket '--threshold=8' not found'. AC2 and the 'test pins help text and parser behaviour together' requirement don't cover flag order.
